channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Clinician-led gene-editing platform may give doctors more control over cell therapies
item.description: An Australian research team led by clinicians has developed a gene-editing platform that could allow doctors greater control over cell therapies.

item.title: New PET imaging detects nearly all lesions in common kidney cancer
item.description: A new PET imaging method identified 97.9% of lesions in clear cell renal cell carcinoma, potentially offering clinicians a more complete view.

item.title: Routine liver cancer screening may extend lives below current thresholds for alcohol-related cirrhosis
item.description: A Mass General Brigham-led study found routine liver cancer screening cost-effective and life-extending for some patients.

item.title: Gentle brain ultrasound may reduce delusions in schizophrenia
item.description: Initial study results suggest targeting a deep brain region with sound waves may safely reduce delusions in people with schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder.
